per_flag_weights_vs_pooled_full_view_202.classification_evidence: Paired week-block bootstrap 95% interval wholly below zero for accuracy and Brier also worse; splitting the flag weight adds variance that out-of-season scoring penalises. Closes only the per-flag weighting variant, not any flag.
per_flag_weights_vs_pooled_full_view_202.description: Four-term pick probability with one LOSO weight per situational flag minus the served single pooled flag weight, full view, opener grade, held-out seasons
per_flag_weights_vs_pooled_full_view_202.plain_summary: Giving each situational flag its own weight did worse on unseen seasons than the single shared weight, so the card keeps the shared weight.
